title: Inside Tour of Chicago’s Fine Arts Building
includes: History and Knowledge of the Fine Arts Building and Solon Spencer Beman
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Take a time travel journey inside Chicago's best-kept secret: a 125-year-old architectural marvel. This extraordinary building was envisioned by renowned architect Solon Spencer Beman, famous for designing the town of Pullman and the iconic Pullman Palace Car Company. Get ready to be transported through time and history as you explore the legacy of this architectural genius and the fascinating stories hidden within these hallowed walls. Join us for an unforgettable adventure into the past and witness the living testament to Beman's architectural prowess.
